name: iPhone 17 Pro (Continuity microphone or offline recording)
kind: MEMS array; primary bottom mic sits on the opposite side of the USB-C port vs. earlier iPhones
connection: Live: Continuity microphone (appears as '<iPhone name> Microphone' / 'Mikrofon von <iPhone name>'). Offline: record `sweeptune sweep export` WAV with an app offering AVAudioSession measurement mode, AirDrop it, then `sweeptune analyze`.
placement: Mic end (bottom) pointing at the ceiling at ear height, held away from the body or on a stand.
notes: APPROXIMATE, VERIFY: Faber Acoustical published an anechoic measurement of the iPhone 17 Pro mic response/directivity (faberacoustical.com, 2025); no numbers are bundled here.
Continuity mode may apply voice processing/AGC; sweeptune runs a two-level AGC check before measuring.
Use `sweeptune mic relcal iphone17pro --ref audyssey` to derive a correction relative to the Audyssey mic.
